decisions.reason: I inspected the complete bound baseline original-PNG content sweep from header through footer. Title, subtitle, notice, all six choice labels and visible details, literal Unavailable status and caller reason, summary, disclosure label, Request station and footer are present with every word/character preserved in wrapped lines, without ellipsis or clipped glyphs. The global guidance body is deliberately collapsed and excluded. Unavailable breaks before its final e because the unbroken segment exceeds the available width; the brief explicitly permits character breaking and no character is lost.

Across the complete bound baseline original-PNG sweep, header, notice, six cards with their labels/details and status/reasons, summary, disclosure, primary action and footer occupy separate successive areas. I observed no unintended text/control overlap or occlusion. Cropping at a scroll viewport edge is resolved by the overlapping exact-state frames; contact-sheet column boundaries are assembly boundaries, not product clipping.
